overview_description.description:
Curacel is an AI-powered platform for claims processing and fraud management.

Curacel automates the insurance claims process, allowing staff to process claims volumes quickly and efficiently, and automatically vets claims to detect fraud, waste and abuse. 

Curacel was established in 2019 by Henry Mascot in Ikoyi, Lagos.

about_short_description.short_description: Curacel is an insurtech company that offers an AI-powered platform for claims processing and fraud management.

product.name: Curacel Health
product.description: An AI-driven platform for processing health insurance claims, enabling rapid handling of large volumes of data with reduced manual effort and fraud detection.

product.name: Curacel Auto
product.description: An AI-powered solution to accelerate auto insurance claims, assessments, and payouts through streamlined digital processes.

product.name: Curacel Pay
product.description: A fintech application that automates insurance and healthcare payments, including claims disbursements and premium collections, with AI-driven reconciliation and security.

product.name: Curacel Grow
product.description: An embedded insurance platform that enables fintech, logistics, credit, and e-commerce companies to integrate and distribute insurance products to expand their customer base and revenue.

product.name: Curacel Claims Detection
product.description: A SaaS AI-based fraud detection system that identifies and prevents fraudulent insurance claims to reduce payouts and protect insurer revenue.
